<cite ref="Sotah 21b:2">Sot. 21ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 8:12">Prov. VIII, 12</cite>) <he>כיון שנכנסה חכמה … נכנסה עמה ע׳</he> (not <he>עמן</he>) when wisdom enters into man, subtlety enters along with it; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 940:12">Yalk.
